parts.zh: 美国海关与边境保护局官员发现
上个月美国一打大号鸡蛋的平均价格达到4.25美元
将鸡蛋带入美国的人面临最高1万美元的罚款
美国海关与边境保护局发言人表示:"通常情况下,这些物品在首次检查时就会申报。然后当事人可以放弃这些鸡蛋而不会产生后果。"
即便如此,最近仍有极少数情况是当局在进一步检查时发现了鸡蛋
W: 我不确定具体数字
M: 我真不敢相信。你真的不是在开玩笑
W: 真的,你看我的表情
M: 难以置信。那你为什么说"可怜的Hannah"?
W: 嗯,结果她已经把钱全花光了

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the egg price in the U.S.?

choices.text: It has gone up sharply.
choices.zh: 价格大幅上涨。

choices.text: It has been fluctuating.
choices.zh: 价格一直在波动。

choices.text: It has risen because of bird flu.
choices.zh: 价格因禽流感而上涨。

choices.text: It has been consumers' concern.
choices.zh: 价格一直是消费者关注的问题。

items.stem: What does the news report say about most people arriving at American borders with eggs?

choices.text: They don't want to abandon their eggs.
choices.zh: 他们不想放弃自己的鸡蛋。

choices.text: They don't know they will be heavily fined.
choices.zh: 他们不知道会被处以重罚。

choices.text: They don't know they are forbidden to bring eggs.
choices.zh: 他们不知道禁止携带鸡蛋。

choices.text: They don't declare their eggs during the inspection.
choices.zh: 他们在检查时没有申报自己的鸡蛋。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report about the restaurant Nettie's House?

choices.text: It is no longer critical of younger customers.
choices.zh: 它不再对年轻顾客持批评态度。

choices.text: It has banned kids under 10 from dining there.
choices.zh: 它已禁止10岁以下儿童在那里就餐。

choices.text: It is no longer as noisy and crowded as before.
choices.zh: 它不再像以前那样嘈杂和拥挤。

choices.text: It has implemented a decision to expand business.
choices.zh: 它已实施了一项扩大业务的决定。

items.stem: What do supporters say in response to the restaurant's new policy?

choices.text: It is fully aware of frequent customers' feelings.
choices.zh: 它充分了解常客的感受。

choices.text: It caters to the tastes of different customers.
choices.zh: 它迎合不同顾客的口味。

choices.text: It is entitled to adopt any rules it wants.
choices.zh: 它有权采用任何它想要的规则。

choices.text: It should announce its decisions online.
choices.zh: 它应该在网上公布其决定。

items.stem: What does the report say security officers were searching for?

choices.text: A missing pet.
choices.zh: 一只走失的宠物。

choices.text: A grown-up snake.
choices.zh: 一条成年蛇。

choices.text: A huge animal skin.
choices.zh: 一张巨大的动物皮。

choices.text: A snake specialist.
choices.zh: 一位蛇类专家。

items.stem: Where does the report say the discovery was made?

choices.text: In a government office.
choices.zh: 在一个政府办公室。

choices.text: In a deserted house.
choices.zh: 在一座废弃的房子里。

choices.text: At a local zoo.
choices.zh: 在当地一家动物园。

choices.text: At a construction site.
choices.zh: 在一处建筑工地。

items.stem: What did the government say would be done if security officers found what they were searching for?

choices.text: Figuring out where it came from.
choices.zh: 查明它来自哪里。

choices.text: Curing it of any possible diseases.
choices.zh: 治疗它可能患有的疾病。

choices.text: Protecting its babies against harm.
choices.zh: 保护它的幼崽免受伤害。

choices.text: Determining how to catch it safely.
choices.zh: 确定如何安全地捕捉它。

items.stem: Why does the woman say she swears it?

choices.text: The man doesn't agree Hannah is poor.
choices.zh: 男人不同意Hannah很穷。

choices.text: The man doesn't believe what she says.
choices.zh: 男人不相信她说的话。

choices.text: The man doesn't think she can be a millionaire.
choices.zh: 男人不认为她能成为百万富翁。

choices.text: The man doesn't consider her to be trustworthy.
choices.zh: 男人不认为她值得信任。

items.stem: What do we learn about Hannah from the conversation?

choices.text: She no longer has any money left.
choices.zh: 她已经没有任何钱了。

choices.text: She has been betrayed by her family.
choices.zh: 她被家人背叛了。

choices.text: She can no longer hold on to her job.
choices.zh: 她不能再保住她的工作了。

choices.text: She has been robbed of 5 million Euros.
choices.zh: 她被抢劫了500万欧元。

items.stem: What does the man think really matters to people?

choices.text: Fortune.
choices.zh: 财富。

choices.text: Family.
choices.zh: 家庭。

choices.text: Harmony.
choices.zh: 和睦。

choices.text: Happiness.
choices.zh: 幸福。

items.stem: What does Hannah's husband say he'll do if she sells the new car?

choices.text: Divorce her.
choices.zh: 和她离婚。

choices.text: Leave home.
choices.zh: 离开家。

choices.text: Buy her a more expensive model.
choices.zh: 给她买一辆更贵的车。

choices.text: Let the best thing happen to them.
choices.zh: 让最好的事情发生在他们身上。

items.stem: What does the man say about Jake?

choices.text: He is not outstanding in Science and Math.
choices.zh: 他在科学和数学方面不突出。

choices.text: He does not have a strong academic record.
choices.zh: 他没有优秀的学业成绩。

choices.text: He is not yet mature enough to live on his own.
choices.zh: 他还不够成熟,无法独立生活。

choices.text: He does not like Westwood Elementary School.
choices.zh: 他不喜欢Westwood小学。

items.stem: Why does the woman feel uncomfortable about sending Jake to Lakeview School?

choices.text: It is too far away.
choices.zh: 太远了。

choices.text: It is newly opened.
choices.zh: 刚开办不久。

choices.text: It lacks outdoor sports facilities.
choices.zh: 缺少户外运动设施。

choices.text: It has too few first-class teachers.
choices.zh: 一流教师太少。

items.stem: What does the man say about their local school?

choices.text: It has a beautiful campus.
choices.zh: 它有美丽的校园。

choices.text: It is within walking distance.
choices.zh: 步行就能到。

choices.text: It has a wonderful arts program.
choices.zh: 它有出色的艺术课程。

choices.text: It is helpful to Jake's breathing problems.
choices.zh: 它对Jake的呼吸问题有帮助。

items.stem: What does the woman suggest at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: Asking Jake which school he himself prefers to enroll in.
choices.zh: 询问Jake本人更愿意就读哪所学校。

choices.text: Thinking twice about what is best for Jake's education next year.
choices.zh: 再三考虑什么对Jake明年的教育最有利。

choices.text: Consulting her mother about which school Jake is to attend.
choices.zh: 咨询她母亲关于Jake该上哪所学校。

choices.text: Sending Jake to the school near the home of the man's mother.
choices.zh: 把Jake送到男士母亲家附近的学校。

items.stem: What does the passage say is a major flaw of analytical decision-making?

choices.text: It is time consuming.
choices.zh: 它耗费时间。

choices.text: It is unfit for crucial issues.
choices.zh: 它不适合关键问题。

choices.text: It relies too much on solid data.
choices.zh: 它过于依赖可靠数据。

choices.text: It dulls a leader's sense of urgency.
choices.zh: 它削弱了领导者的紧迫感。

items.stem: What does a leader tend to do when they are committed to analytical decision-making?

choices.text: Depend on digital technology.
choices.zh: 依赖数字技术。

choices.text: Make assumptions and guesses.
choices.zh: 做出假设和猜测。

choices.text: Ignore others' thoughts and ideas.
choices.zh: 忽视他人的想法和意见。

choices.text: Lay emphasis on thinking flexibly.
choices.zh: 强调灵活思考。

items.stem: What is a key strength of analytical decision-making?

choices.text: Maximizing the advantage of available resources.
choices.zh: 最大化可用资源的优势。

choices.text: Minimizing the possibility of a wrong decision.
choices.zh: 最小化错误决策的可能性。

choices.text: Discovering new potential markets.
choices.zh: 发现新的潜在市场。

choices.text: Perfecting promotional strategies.
choices.zh: 完善推广策略。

items.stem: What do we learn about Branyas Morera?

choices.text: She is one of the world's best-known pianists.
choices.zh: 她是世界上最著名的钢琴家之一。

choices.text: She celebrated her 110th birthday this April.
choices.zh: 她在今年四月庆祝了她的110岁生日。

choices.text: She moved to the U.S. at a young age.
choices.zh: 她在年轻时移居美国。

choices.text: She is the world's oldest individual.
choices.zh: 她是世界上最年长的个人。

items.stem: What is one of Branyas Morera's secrets to living a long life?

choices.text: Being always active on social media.
choices.zh: 在社交媒体上始终保持活跃。

choices.text: Doing regular and vigorous exercise.
choices.zh: 进行规律且高强度的运动。

choices.text: Playing the piano from a young age.
choices.zh: 从小弹钢琴。

choices.text: Following a specific diet every day.
choices.zh: 每天遵循特定的饮食。

items.stem: What does Branyas Morera think also contributes to a long life?

choices.text: Eating as little as one can possibly manage.
choices.zh: 尽可能少吃。

choices.text: Having the ability to forget things selectively.
choices.zh: 有选择性地忘记事情的能力。

choices.text: Figuring out the positive properties of each food item.
choices.zh: 弄清每种食物的有益特性。

choices.text: Knowing how to remember major events in one's life.
choices.zh: 知道如何记住人生中的重大事件。

items.stem: What is of great importance to students according to the speaker?

choices.text: The ability to learn.
choices.zh: 学习能力。

choices.text: The first day of school.
choices.zh: 开学第一天。

choices.text: How teachers perceive them.
choices.zh: 教师如何看待他们。

choices.text: Where they sit in the classroom.
choices.zh: 他们在教室里坐在哪里。

items.stem: What did one study find about students seated in the middle of the classroom?

choices.text: They often received close attention from the instructors.
choices.zh: 他们经常受到教师的密切关注。

choices.text: They obtained the highest grade average in their class.
choices.zh: 他们获得了班级中最高的平均成绩。

choices.text: They actually wanted a clear vision of the blackboard.
choices.zh: 他们实际上想要清楚地看到黑板。

choices.text: They scored higher than students sitting behind them.
choices.zh: 他们的分数高于坐在他们后面的学生。

items.stem: What can eye contact, visibility and more interaction probably bring about?

choices.text: A higher grade average among all students of a class.
choices.zh: 一个班级所有学生的平均成绩更高。

choices.text: A better connection between instructors and students.
choices.zh: 教师与学生之间更好的联系。

choices.text: A stronger support for a student-centered teaching approach.
choices.zh: 对以学生为中心的教学方法更有力的支持。

choices.text: A more favorable atmosphere for effective classroom learning.
choices.zh: 更有利于有效课堂学习的氛围。

items.stem: What do we learn about extremely shy students sitting in the front row of the classroom?

choices.text: They may experience some unwanted stress.
choices.zh: 他们可能会经历一些不必要的压力。

choices.text: They may try hard to show their preparedness.
choices.zh: 他们可能会努力展示自己的准备情况。

choices.text: They may receive extra attention from the instructor.
choices.zh: 他们可能会受到教师的额外关注。

choices.text: They may feel helpless when called on by the instructor.
choices.zh: 他们在被教师点名时可能会感到无助。
